recurring_entries_party_shape.name: recurring_entries_party_shape
recurring_entries_party_shape.value:
("recurring_entries"."kind"::text = 'bill' and "recurring_entries"."vendor_id" is not null and "recurring_entries"."customer_id" is null)
       or ("recurring_entries"."kind"::text = 'invoice' and "recurring_entries"."customer_id" is not null and "recurring_entries"."vendor_id" is null)
       or ("recurring_entries"."kind"::text = 'journal' and "recurring_entries"."vendor_id" is null and "recurring_entries"."customer_id" is null)

documents_filed_at_requires_folder.name: documents_filed_at_requires_folder
documents_filed_at_requires_folder.value: "documents"."folder_id" is not null or "documents"."filed_at" is null

crm_affiliations_primary_idx.name: crm_affiliations_primary_idx
crm_affiliations_primary_idx.where: is_primary = true and ended_on is null

crm_pipelines_default_idx.name: crm_pipelines_default_idx
crm_pipelines_default_idx.where: is_default = true and archived_at is null

work_items_starts_before_due.name: work_items_starts_before_due
work_items_starts_before_due.value: "work_items"."starts_on" is null or "work_items"."due_on" is null or "work_items"."starts_on" <= "work_items"."due_on"

brand_kits_logo_whole.name: brand_kits_logo_whole
brand_kits_logo_whole.value:
("brand_kits"."logo_pathname" is null and "brand_kits"."logo_mime_type" = '' and "brand_kits"."logo_width" = 0 and "brand_kits"."logo_height" = 0 and "brand_kits"."logo_bytes" = 0)
        or ("brand_kits"."logo_pathname" is not null and "brand_kits"."logo_mime_type" <> '' and "brand_kits"."logo_width" > 0 and "brand_kits"."logo_height" > 0 and "brand_kits"."logo_bytes" > 0)

ams_interval_matches_kind.name: ams_interval_matches_kind
ams_interval_matches_kind.value:
("asset_maintenance_schedules"."kind" = 'calendar' and "asset_maintenance_schedules"."interval_months" > 0 and "asset_maintenance_schedules"."interval_meter" is null)
       or ("asset_maintenance_schedules"."kind" = 'meter' and "asset_maintenance_schedules"."interval_meter" > 0 and "asset_maintenance_schedules"."interval_months" is null)

assets_depreciable_is_complete.name: assets_depreciable_is_complete
assets_depreciable_is_complete.value:
"assets"."depreciation_method" = 'none' or (
        "assets"."in_service_on" is not null
        and "assets"."useful_life_months" is not null
        and "assets"."acquisition_cost_cents" is not null
      )

inventory_items_purchase_unit_complete.name: inventory_items_purchase_unit_complete
inventory_items_purchase_unit_complete.value: "inventory_items"."purchase_unit_qty" is null or ("inventory_items"."purchase_unit" is not null and "inventory_items"."purchase_unit_qty" > 0)

livestock_identifiers_range_ordered.name: livestock_identifiers_range_ordered
livestock_identifiers_range_ordered.value: "livestock_identifiers"."removed_on" is null or "livestock_identifiers"."applied_on" is null or "livestock_identifiers"."removed_on" >= "livestock_identifiers"."applied_on"

livestock_weights_has_a_reading.name: livestock_weights_has_a_reading
livestock_weights_has_a_reading.value: "livestock_weights"."sample_weight_lb" is not null or "livestock_weights"."heart_girth_in" is not null

production_order_lines_price_has_unit.name: production_order_lines_price_has_unit
production_order_lines_price_has_unit.value: "production_order_lines"."unit_price_cents" is null or "production_order_lines"."unit" is not null

production_orders_attached.name: production_orders_attached
production_orders_attached.value: "production_orders"."booking_id" is not null or "production_orders"."run_id" is not null

retail_sale_lines_weighed_has_total.name: retail_sale_lines_weighed_has_total
retail_sale_lines_weighed_has_total.value: "retail_sale_lines"."weight_lb" is null or "retail_sale_lines"."line_total_cents" is not null
